payload.summary: A compassionate idea reaches the person or institution capable of funding a first practical response.
payload.body: A compassionate idea reaches the person or institution capable of funding a first practical response. Jupiter sextile Neptune can connect a larger vision with the money, audience, or support needed to give it form. A grant, shelter plan, relief payment, or public appeal works because the beneficiary and immediate use are clear. Hope becomes more credible when it has an address and a person responsible for delivery. Use the opening to fund one defined need instead of trying to solve everything at once.
